scenes.title: A boat on pier four
scenes.summary: Party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them to the old chapel for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, with warm water.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: Warm, candle-wax-smelling air; the tunnel floods thirty paces in. Teo finds a hymn-book page annotated "M. Brand" in his sister Mira's handwriting. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is much louder, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor. The party flees. GM notes the choir clock at three of six.

scenes.title: Stew at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: Party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide tomorrow, with Sela rowing at first light. Innkeeper Bram speaks well of harbor-master Maren, who lost a brother to the bay. Long rest.
